---
title: About
---

This page exists to round out the minimal website. Together with the
[Home page](index.qmd), it demonstrates three things:

1. **Multi-page project rendering.** Running `quarto render` on the
   project directory walks every `.qmd`, builds a project-wide index
   of document profiles, and renders each page with that index in
   scope.
2. **Manual sidebar configuration.** A `website.sidebar.contents:`
   list whose entries are bare `.qmd` paths produces a working
   sidebar with one entry per page. The visible label comes from
   the target page's `title:`.
3. **Cross-document link rewriting.** When you write
   `[About](about.qmd)` in a paragraph, the rendered HTML contains
   `<a href="about.html">`. The same is true of the link back to
   `[Home](index.qmd)` above. You don't need to write the `.html`
   extension yourself — and you shouldn't, because the source path
   is what's stable across format choices.
